common_narratives: General coverage assumes route optimization is a solved static shortest-path problem rather than dynamic real-time fleet reconciliation.
competing_viewpoints: Dispatch operators fear autonomous re-routing might disrupt driver schedules or violate rest-break compliance.
missing_context_in_market: How edge telematics and real-time traffic variance enable sub-second dispatch rebalancing.
underexplored_angles: Multi-stop last-mile fleet orchestration balancing fuel burn, delivery windows, and road congestion.
